answer: Admission auction blocks fakes: 200 slots sell each epoch. Each bidder locks 60 days of earnings for 20 epochs, a horizon that blocks capital cycling. The auction floor is the nadir of entry cost; bids are public, so mirror copies of one operator cannot hide: each copy pays its bid. 100 fakes cost 100 bids, 6,000 days locked; shared keys burn the bond. An honest agent pays once for undiluted rewards; fakes outbid each other, not recycle one bond.
